forbidden.title: You are not allowed to do that

conflict.title: Somebody else changed this in the meantime

localized.missing: Fill this field in for every language of the division.

url.absolute: Enter a full address starting with http:// or https://

number.min: Enter a number that is not smaller than the minimum.

locale.unsupported: The division does not publish in that language.

media.tooLarge: This file is larger than this hub accepts.
media.typeNotAllowed: This hub does not accept files of that kind.

slug.invalid: Use lower case letters, digits and single dashes.

body.notAnObject: This page has no content yet.
body.tooLarge: This page is too large to save. Move some of it to a page of its own.
body.schemaVersion: This page was written by a newer version of the hub.
body.tooDeep: Sections cannot be nested any deeper than this.
body.idMissing: This section or block has lost its identifier.
body.idDuplicated: Two sections or blocks share one identifier.
body.blockTypeMissing: This block does not say what it is.
body.blockTypeUnknown: This block is of a type the hub does not know.
body.templateOnlyKey: Only a template may fix this. Change it on the template instead.
body.layoutUnknown: This section asks for a layout that does not exist.
body.renderModeUnknown: This block asks to be drawn in a way that does not exist.
body.backgroundUnknown: This section asks for a background that does not exist.
body.columnOutOfRange: This block is in a column its section does not have.
body.sourceNotText: The code of this block is not text.
body.sourceTooLarge: The code of this block is too long. Keep an animation small: it travels with the page.

content.templateNotPublishable: A template is not published: make a page from it and publish that.
content.mediaMissing: This picture is no longer in the media library. Choose another one.
content.mediaNotVisible: This picture is not visible to the readers of this page. Make it public in the media library, or choose another one.
content.notADocument: Only a document carries this. Leave it empty on a page or a news item.
content.successorUnknown: The document that replaces this one does not exist. Pick one from the list.
content.successorWithoutRetirement: A document with a successor is no longer in force: say since when.

address.reserved: The site already uses this address for one of its own screens. Choose another.
address.topLevel: Only the director and the web team put a page at the top of the site. Choose a page to put it under.
address.tooDeep: A page goes three levels deep at most, counting the pages under it.
address.invalidParent: A page cannot go under this one: it is not a page, or it is this page or one under it.
address.notAPage: Only a page sits under another page.
address.taken: Another page already has this address.

review.notReviewed: This kind of content is published directly, without approval.
review.unknownAction: This is not something a review can do.
review.alreadyReady: This page is already waiting for approval.
review.notReady: This page is not waiting for approval.
review.inReview: This page is waiting for approval and cannot be changed. Withdraw it from the review to change it.
review.menuParent: A menu entry goes under an entry at the top of the menu.

maintenance.title: This part of the site is closed for changes right now

grant.unknownPermission: This installation has no permission by that name.
grant.globalPermission: A permission that is not scoped to a department cannot be granted by hand.
grant.notStaff: That VID is not staff of this division, or has never signed in.
grant.alreadyExpired: Choose a date in the future, or leave it empty for a grant that does not expire.

superadmin.neverLoggedIn: That VID has never signed in, so the hub knows nothing about them yet.
superadmin.lastOne: The last super administrator cannot be removed.

notifications.unknownType: That is not a kind of notification this hub sends.

calendar.endsBeforeStart: This entry ends before it starts.
calendar.kindUnknown: This is not one of the kinds the division uses. Pick one from the list.
calendar.colourUnknown: This is not one of the colours a chip can take.

menu.pathNotAllowed: A menu entry leads to a page of this site, to one of its screens, or to a link of the library. Anywhere else is added to the links first, so that every outside address lives in one place.
menu.parentInvalid: That entry cannot be the parent of this one: a menu goes one level deep, and both have to be in the same menu.

path.invalid: An address of this site starts with a slash. Anywhere else needs its full address, http or https.
